declared_by: drafted by a coding agent (Claude Code) before any calibration result was computed; acceptance criteria not revised after seeing results
scope: procedures owned by this repository's directional-consistency framework. The composition arm's and the enrichment arm's native procedures are not evaluated here; their adapters belong to their owners (#182 assigns them), and the assertion-level urn of #131 is a separate model question.

procedures.null: for each Table 1 trait, a study is equally likely to shift its annotation share up or down between the increased and decreased signatures
procedures.estimand: share of non-tied studies shifting up
procedures.family: Benjamini-Hochberg over the six Table 1 traits
procedures.claimed_error_rate: per-test level 0.05 for the exact binomial; BH false discovery rate 0.05 over the six

procedures.null: for each ordered trait pair, a study's paired log2(A/B) change is equally likely to be positive or negative
procedures.estimand: share of non-tied eligible studies shifting up
procedures.claimed_error_rate: per-test level 0.05; BY false discovery rate 0.05 under arbitrary dependence

procedures.null: among studies whose aerobe and anaerobe signs disagree, either direction of disagreement is equally likely
procedures.estimand: odds ratio of discordant study signs

procedures.null: as fraction_sign_test, but the traits tested are chosen inside the replicate as the three with the largest absolute deviation from a half-and-half split, and corrected over those three only
procedures.estimand: as fraction_sign_test, on the selected traits
procedures.family: Benjamini-Hochberg over the three selected traits
procedures.claimed_error_rate: none claimed; this procedure is expected to be anticonservative and is measured to quantify by how much

null_generation.design: paired direction flip on the real corpus: for a sampled half of the units, the increased and decreased labels of every profile in that unit are exchanged
null_generation.exchangeability: under each procedure's null the two sides of a pair are exchangeable, so flipping their labels leaves the distribution unchanged. Flipping whole studies also preserves the dependence between a study's experiments; flipping whole experiments is reported beside it because the choice of unit changes the null.
preserved_by_construction: whole annotation vectors, including correlations between traits

signal_injection.design: multiply one trait's counts on the increased side by a factor for a random share of studies, adding the difference to that profile's total so the remaining shares stay coherent
signal_injection.purpose: power for the injected trait, and the false-discovery proportion among the traits left untouched

acceptance_criteria.criterion: under the complete null, the 95% Monte Carlo interval for the per-test rejection rate at p <= 0.05 includes 0.05, or lies below it
under the complete null, the rate of replicates with at least one q <= 0.05 is at most 0.10
under injected signal, power for the injected trait is reported with its Monte Carlo interval; no threshold is set
reported, not judged: the rejection rate under the complete null is expected to exceed the nominal level

reporting_rules: discrete test statistics make the attainable p-values a finite set; uniformity of p is not required and the attainable resolution is reported
Monte Carlo uncertainty is reported as an exact binomial interval over replicates
a failed criterion is reported as failed; no procedure is tuned against these simulations
not_covered: the enrichment arm's hypergeometric urn (#131) and the composition arm's native transform (owners' adapters)
the aggregated profile-support rule of #177, whose code is not on main
any claim that a calibrated procedure makes its biological interpretation valid

amendments.change: the single injected multiplier of 1.3 was replaced by a declared curve of 1.1, 1.3, 2.0 and 4.0
amendments.reason: the first run showed a 1.3x lift moves almost no study signs, so power was ~0 and the scenario was uninformative; a curve reports where the procedures start to detect an effect
amendments.unchanged: the null scenarios, the acceptance criteria and every threshold
